Revised assessment: The statement couples a rate hike with “gradual” guidance and sub-2% inflation, a stance consistent with the forward‑looking Taylor‑rule framework and policy gradualism emphasized by Clarida, Galí, and Gertler. Its explicit reference to a symmetric 2% objective and reliance on forward guidance are aligned with inflation‑forecast targeting best practice discussed by Svensson and Woodford (2005). Operational details (IOER/ON RRP corridor and balance sheet runoff) reflect modern implementation themes in Goodfriend (2002). Net tone is moderately positive on growth and labor markets, but cautious on inflation—thus slightly more positive than neutral.
